subject.title: [Feature]: Thread replies when agent uses tools; top-level for conversational responses

question: Should Slack support default-off tool-use-sensitive reply placement, and should that behavior extend `replyToMode` or live as a separate `channels.slack.thread.replyOnToolUse` flag?
rationale: This would add operator-visible Slack config and change visible reply placement after tool use, so maintainers need to choose precedence, streaming behavior, and upgrade semantics before implementation.

options.title: Extend Reply Mode
options.body: Add an explicit Slack reply-placement mode or policy under the existing `replyToMode` family so account, chat-type, and per-channel precedence stay in one model.

options.title: Add Separate Flag
options.body: Add the proposed default-off `thread.replyOnToolUse` flag and document exactly how it composes with static reply modes, DMs, streaming, and tool sends.

options.title: Decline Heuristic
options.body: Keep static `replyToMode` and per-channel overrides as the supported way to reduce Slack clutter, and document that OpenClaw does not infer thread placement from tool use.

recommendation.title: Extend Reply Mode
recommendation.body: Add an explicit Slack reply-placement mode or policy under the existing `replyToMode` family so account, chat-type, and per-channel precedence stay in one model.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete merged the closest static reply-placement change and has recent history on the affected Slack config/routing surface.
